desc.zh-CN: OpenAI官方最新推出的备受外界期待的、性能更强的新一代人工智能模型GPT-5.
desc.en-US: The latest, highly anticipated and powerful next-generation LLM named GPT-5 that officially launched by OpenAI.

desc.zh-CN: o3是openai发布的最新深度思考模型，其基线指标大幅超越上一代模型。
desc.en-US: O3 is the latest reasoning model released by OpenAI, with baseline metrics significantly surpassing previous models.

desc.zh-CN: 字节豆包推出的seed系列模型的最新版，支持思考模式。
desc.en-US: The latest version of the seed series model launched by ByteDance, whitch supports the thinking mode.

desc.zh-CN: xAI推出的Grok模型系列的最新版。
desc.en-US: The latest version of the Grok model series released by xAI.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3是Qwen系列中最新一代的大型语言模型，提供了一套全面的密集模型和MoE模型。
desc.en-US: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.

desc.zh-CN: Deepseek R1的最新版本。
desc.en-US: The latest version of Deepseek R1.

desc.zh-CN: high模式下的o4-mini，响应时间更长，具有更强的推理能力。
desc.en-US: o4-mini in high mode, which has a longer response time and stronger reasoning ability.

desc.zh-CN: gemini2.5-pro模型的正式发布版本。
desc.en-US: The official release version of the Gemini 2.5 pro.

desc.zh-CN: GLM发布的新一代GLM-4.5系列开源推理模型。
desc.en-US: The new GLM-4.5 reasoning model series released by GLM.

desc.zh-CN: 由腾讯公司自主研发的深度思考模型，所采用的版本号为hunyuan-t1-20250711。
desc.en-US: The deep reasoning model independently developed by Tencent adopts the version number hunyuan-t1-20250711.

desc.zh-CN: Anthropic最新发布的混合推理模型系列，支持更好的代码编写、工件调用等功能。
desc.en-US: The latest hybrid inference model series released by Anthropic, which support better coding, function calling, and other features.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3是Qwen系列中最新一代的大型语言模型，提供了一套全面的密集模型和MoE模型。
desc.en-US: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.

desc.zh-CN: GLM发布的新一代GLM-4.5系列开源推理模型。
desc.en-US: The new GLM-4.5 reasoning model series released by GLM.

desc.zh-CN: 由月之暗面公司最新推出的模型，具备更强代码能力、更擅长通用Agent任务的MoE架构模型。
desc.en-US: The latest model launched by Moonshot AI, featuring enhanced coding capabilities and superior performance in general Agent tasks, built on an MoE architecture.

desc.zh-CN: 文心X1的升级版X1 Turbo，性能提升的同时，具备更先进的思维链，问答、创作、逻辑推理、工具调用和多模态能力进一步增强。
desc.en-US: The upgraded version X1 Turbo of ERNIE X1 not only enhances performance, but also has a more advanced thinking chain, including question answering, creation, logical reasoning, tool calling, and multimodal capabilities.

desc.zh-CN: Minimax发布的全球首个开源大规模混合注意力推理模型。
desc.en-US: The world's first open-weight, large-scale hybrid-attention reasoning model released by Minimax.

desc.zh-CN: DeepSeek-V3 多项评测成绩超越了 Qwen2.5-72B 和 Llama-3.1-405B 等其他开源模型，并在性能上和世界顶尖的闭源模型 GPT-4o 以及 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 不分伯仲。
desc.en-US: DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models such as Qwen2.5-72B and Llama-3.1-405B in multiple evaluations and matches the performance of top-tier closed-source models like GPT-4 and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.

desc.zh-CN: 科大讯飞发布的推理模型星火X1，在原来数学任务国内领先基础上，推理、文本生成、语言理解等通用任务实现效果对标OpenAI o系列和DeepSeek R1。
desc.en-US: The inference model Spark X1 released by iFlytek, on the basis of leading domestic mathematical tasks, benchmarks the performance of general tasks such as inference, text generation, and language understanding against OpenAI o series and DeepSeek R1.

desc.zh-CN: 由蚂蚁集团发布的金融领域大模型。
desc.en-US: The financial domain LLM released by Ant Group.

desc.zh-CN: 腾讯最新发布的开源MoE模型。
desc.en-US: The latest open-sourced MoE model released by Tencent.

desc.zh-CN: 由OpenAI推出的GPT-4.1系列模型，在编码、指令遵循和长上下文方面有重大改进。
desc.en-US: The GPT-4.1 series models launched by OpenAI, which have significant improvements in encoding, instruction adherence, and long context.

desc.zh-CN: 百度文心一言系列模型的最新开源版本。
desc.en-US: The latest open source version of Baidu ERNIE series LLMs.

desc.zh-CN: 星火认知大模型是由科大讯飞出品的 API 模型，所使用的版本号是星火 v4.0 Ultra。
desc.en-US: The Spark Cognitive Large Model is an API model produced by iFlytek, with the version number being Spark v4.0 Ultra.

desc.zh-CN: 百灵语言大模型是通用语言大模型，已通过生成式人工智能上线备案。基于万亿级Token语料训练而练成，所使用的版本号是Bailing-Pro-20250225。
desc.en-US: The Bailing Large Language Model is a general-purpose LLM that has completed the generative AI filing process, trained on trillions of tokens. It adopts the version number Bailing-Pro-20250225.

desc.zh-CN: Llama 4模型是自回归语言模型，它使用混合专家（MoE）架构，并结合了原生多模态的早期融合。
desc.en-US: The Llama 4 models are auto-regressive language models that use a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture and incorporate early fusion for native multimodality.

desc.zh-CN: Gemma 是来自谷歌的一系列轻量级、最先进的开源模型家族，这些模型基于创建Gemini模型相同的研究和技术构建而成。
desc.en-US: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built from the same research and technology used to create the Gemini models.

desc.zh-CN: 百灵语言大模型是通用语言大模型，已通过生成式人工智能上线备案。基于万亿级Token语料训练而练成，所使用的版本号是Bailing-Lite-20250220。
desc.en-US: The Bailing Large Language Model is a general-purpose LLM that has completed the generative AI filing process, trained on trillions of tokens. It adopts the version number Bailing-Lite-20250220.

desc.zh-CN: Minimmax-text-01是一个功能强大的语言模型，总共有4560亿个参数，其中每个令牌激活459亿个参数。为了更好地解锁模型的长上下文功能，Minimmax-text-01采用了一种混合架构，结合了Lightning Attention、Softmax Attention和混合专家（MoE）。
desc.en-US: MiniMax-Text-01 is a powerful language model with 456 billion total parameters, of which 45.9 billion are activated per token. To better unlock the long context capabilities of the model, MiniMax-Text-01 adopts a hybrid architecture that combines Lightning Attention, Softmax Attention and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE).
